trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all three regions — confirmed rolled out.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002** describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and pending root-cause analysis. The on-call engineer has been paged. (The first incident-creation request timed out; I verified no incident had been created before retrying to avoid duplicate pages.)
3. **Verified recovery:** the service is now healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.2%.

Note: I did not need change-manager approval since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
